function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Research the publicly documented OneCoin/Cryptoqueen fraud scheme using only sources for which you can provide the benchmark tool's exact source IDs. Produce an evidence-led dossier, prioritizing official court opinions and filings, prosecution or law-enforcement releases, regulatory or government records, and then reputable investigative or analytical sources if primary sources do not cover an issue. Cover: (1) the scheme's structure and operation, including what OneCoin represented, how packages, tokens, educational products, commissions, and the purported blockchain/mining function operated, but distinguish proven enforcement facts from allegations or analytical assessments; (2) a chronological timeline of publicly documented events and enforcement actions; (3) principal founders and other key actors, identifying each person's role only when the cited evidence supports it; (4) for every important point, classify the evidentiary status as established fact, allegation/charge, investigative or analytical assessment, or unresolved claim; and (5) Ruja Ignatova's current documented status as of October 1, 2026, separating confirmed facts (such as indictment, disappearance, warrants, official listings, or confirmed sightings if any) from unverified reports, theories, and uncertainty. Explicitly identify conflicts between sources, dates, role descriptions, or claims. Do not invent entity IDs, relationship names, or facts. Return a structured set of findings with exact source IDs, quoted or tightly paraphrased support, and enough detail for a final report that can cite only those source IDs."}
function.name: ConductResearch
